notes:
The agent can now mark emails as read - it used to tell you to go do it in Gmail yourself. Ask it to clear your unread or mark the marketing mail read: it shows you what it's about to touch first, and only marks them once you say yes. Say "marketing" or "these newsletters" and it leaves real customer mail alone.

Memory no longer needs a refresh. When chat says "saved to memory", the Memory screen shows it straight away instead of looking empty until you press the refresh button.
